revisions.title: Policy — review and CI pass before every merge
revisions.summary: Every merge to main needs a passing automated review and CI run.
revisions.body:
# Scope
Changes merged into the main branch of the example repository.

# Rule or procedure
1. Run the quick check before pushing.
2. Open a pull request; an automated review and CI must pass before merge.

# Exceptions and stop conditions
Stop and ask a person when a check cannot run.

# Source
Team agreement recorded in the decision log.
